name: sync-ticket-artifact
description: Internal helper. Reads the ticket + transcript + diagnoses + escalations from Postgres, then upserts a single substrate source_artifact (external_system=support_recipe, external_id=ticket_id) with the full conversation as content and structured ticket state under attrs. Called by widget-ingest, widget-followup, auto-reply-worker, send-draft-reply, execute-escalation, and SupportTicketDO so substrate always reflects the latest ticket state.
